Business opportunities

Business opportunities

About us - business opportunities - intro

Are you looking for business opportunities with us?

We buy services and supplies through public procurement calls, in line with the EU financial regulation and principles of transparency, equal treatment and non-discrimination, widest competition, proportionality and sound financial management.

You can find all our calls for tender that cover IT, scientific, logistical, legal and other support services below.

Read our public procurement procedures and guidelines document for more information on specific procurement types.

If you have questions on a specific call for tender, you can ask directly on the funding and tenders portal. For other questions related to ECHA procurements and contracts, contact us.
